name: error-state
description: A failure with one retry. Title names the failure; the line says what to do.
avoidWhen: Do not use for an empty collection; use empty-state. Do not use for loading.

ux.behaviour: One title naming the failure, one line, one retry; TalkBack announces the copy
ux.why: Empty is a fact; this is a failure with a next step

ux.behaviour: The action is a full AppButton
ux.why: Retry should feel like every other action

aiHints: Always pass a retry action; an error without a next step is a dead end
Do not add a second button
